html:
Question 2
?

Let f(x) be a function with f(7)=4,f′(7)=2,f″(7)=−6 and f‴(7)=−24. Which of the following is the third-degree Taylor polynomial for f(x) about x=7?

a
4+(x−7)−(x−7)2−4(x−7)3
b
4+2(x−7)−(x−7)2−6(x−7)3
c
4+2(x−7)−3(x−7)2−6(x−7)3
d
4+2(x−7)−3(x−7)2−4(x−7)3
e
4+2(x−7)−2(x−7)2−8(x−7)3
Submit
